subtitle: A St. Elizabeth fishing village of five coves, nine months into rebuilding after Hurricane Melissa, the strongest hurricane on record to hit Jamaica.
spike_statement: Hurricane Melissa hit Jamaica at 185 mph on 28 Oct 2025, the strongest hurricane on record to strike the island; St. Elizabeth recorded 18 deaths.

levers.photo_tone: Brown south-coast sand and turquoise shallows at Frenchman's Bay, fishing boats pulled up on rebuilt seawalls at Calabash Bay, new zinc roofs still bright against weathered pastel guesthouses, storm-bent almond trees regrowing their canopy.
